title: Paul McCartney live: Palacio de los Deportes, Mexico City | 2002
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Palacio de los Deportes in Mexico City, Mexico, on 2 November 2002.

It was the 51st date of the Driving World Tour, which lasted for 58 dates across four countries between April and November 2002, and the first of three non-consecutive nights in Mexico City.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
